title: 第539章 天机漏痕混沌显诸圣齐动西方危第538章 宏愿锁位圣位出灵宝入体双圣归
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
洪荒天地，万古澄澈，唯有大劫将至的暗流，始终在天机底层悄然翻涌。
自五道天道封印接连现世、层层解封以来，整片天地的天机脉络便愈发紊乱。
大劫气机交织、气运重新洗牌，寻常大能推演天机，往往得残缺虚影、得破碎碎片，难窥全貌，便是圣人出手推演，也时常遭遇天机遮蔽、道韵阻隔。
往日种种异动，诸圣皆视作量劫开启的正常乱象，见怪不怪，各自稳坐道场、静观时局、伺机而动。
可今日，盘踞九天之上的玉虚天宫，一缕极细微、却极刺眼的天机裂痕，悄然撕开了层层遮掩，落入元始天尊的感知之中。
玉虚宫内，云气缭绕，仙乐沉静，玉清道韵静静盘踞大殿，一派肃穆清正之景。
元始端坐太清莲台，一身素白道袍不染尘埃，面容清冷威严，眸光俯瞰周天星斗，常年执掌阐教秩序、梳理天地法理，早已养成万事尽在掌控的从容心性。
殿内两侧，广成子、赤精子、燃灯道人等一众阐教金仙分列肃立，屏息凝神，无人妄动。
玉虚宫规矩森严，圣人静坐之时，天地无声、万籁俱寂，从无半分躁动紊乱之气。
元始原本闭目养神，默默梳理天道法理、推演大劫走向，心神恬淡、波澜不惊。可下一瞬，他眉心道印微微一颤，周身平稳流转的清正道韵，悄然滞涩半分。
细微至极的异变，常人、金仙乃至准圣皆无从察觉，可落在元始这等执掌诸天秩序、洞悉天机本源的圣人眼中，却清晰得刺眼。
他缓缓睁开双目，眸中星河流转、法理沉浮，淡淡眸光扫过东南天际，语气平静无波，带着一丝审视：“东南风泽之地，天机紊乱，道韵逆行。”
起初，元始并未放在心上。
封神量劫步步逼近，天道封印层层解封，洪荒各处皆有机缘异动、天机震荡，东南一隅出现道韵波动，本就是情理之中的寻常乱象。
在他最初的判断里，这不过是又一处先天秘境开启、低级机缘现世，无需圣人亲自动身，只需遣派门下金仙前往探查、顺势摘取机缘即可。
一贯以来，阐教便是如此行事，稳坐高台、推演先机、遣徒争运，从不贸然亲赴险地，始终维持玄门首座的体面与从容。
元始抬手，指尖一缕清光流转，欲推演全貌、锁定机缘品级与阵眼坐标，打算摸清底细后，再从容分派门人入局摘桃。
可这一次，指尖天机推演，并未如往常一般顺畅通透。
清光触碰到东南天机的刹那，骤然被一层厚重苍茫的混沌雾气阻隔、反弹，无数破碎、紊乱、扭曲的天机碎片疯狂倒涌而来，密密麻麻充斥在推演脉络之中。
“嗯？”

元始眉峰微蹙，眼底多出几分讶异。
寻常秘境、先天禁制，根本挡不住圣人推演，更不可能反弹玉虚道韵、扭曲天机脉络。这等厚重的混沌遮蔽，绝非普通机缘所能拥有。
他收敛轻视之心，不再随意推演，眉心圣道全力运转，浩瀚磅礴的圣人之力灌入天机之中，强行拨开层层迷雾、撕碎重重遮掩，执意窥探东南异变的真相。
随着混沌迷雾被层层拨开，破碎的天机碎片渐渐拼凑成型，一股超脱先天、逼近大道的本源气息，缓缓浮出水面。
混沌气！
纯正、磅礴、古老的混沌本源气息，隔着亿万万里虚空，依旧清晰传入玉虚天宫，浩荡苍茫、碾压诸天。
元始眸光骤然一凝，原本松弛的指节悄然收紧，清冷的面容第一次褪去从容，多了几分凝重。
“混沌层级的异动？”
他低声自语，心底瞬间翻涌诸多思绪。
前番第五道天道封印归元青莲现世，乃是盘古本源衍生的顶尖机缘，本该落入阐教手中，最终却阴差阳错被各方牵制、错失先手，让旁门钻了空子，白白错失一件混沌层级至宝的机缘。
此事始终是元始心中的一根刺，看似波澜不惊，实则耿耿于怀。
身为阐教之主，执掌洪荒正统法理，却接连错失天道顶级机缘，眼睁睁看着别家势力稳步崛起、底蕴暴涨，早已让他心生不耐与隐忍。
如今再度出现混沌层级的天道异动，无疑是大劫开启以来，又一次改写格局的关键契机。
元始心底的克制，已然悄然松动。
content_en:
The prehistoric world has been clear for all eternity, but the undercurrent of impending disaster has always been quietly surging at the bottom of the universe.
Since the five heavenly seals appeared one after another and were unsealed layer by layer, the heavenly secrets of the entire world have become increasingly chaotic.
Great tribulations interweave and reshuffle fortunes. Ordinary powers who deduce heaven's secrets often end up with incomplete shadows and broken fragments, making it difficult to see the whole picture. Even saints who try to deduce heaven's secrets often encounter obstructions from heaven's secrets and Taoist rhymes.
All the abnormal movements in the past were regarded by the saints as normal chaos caused by the start of the calamity. They were not surprised. They each sat firmly in the dojo, quietly observing the situation, and waiting for opportunities to act.
But today, in the Yuxu Heavenly Palace entrenched above the Nine Heavens, a very subtle but extremely dazzling crack in the heavenly secrets quietly tore through the layers of cover and fell into the perception of Yuanshi Tianzun.
In the Yuxu Palace, the clouds are lingering, the fairy music is quiet, and the Yuqing Taoist rhyme quietly dominates the main hall, creating a solemn and upright scene.
Yuanshi sat on the Taiqing lotus platform, wearing a plain white Taoist robe that was not stained by dust, with a cold and majestic face, and his eyes overlooking the stars in the sky. He had been in charge of explaining the religious order and sorting out the laws of heaven and earth for many years, and he had long developed a calm mind that was able to control everything.
On both sides of the hall, Guangchengzi, Chi Jingjing, Randeng Taoist and other golden immortals stood in rows and stood in awe, holding their breaths and concentrating, no one moved rashly.
The rules of Yuxu Palace are strict. When the saint sits in meditation, the heaven and earth are silent and everything is still, and there is never any restlessness or disorder.
Yuan Shi originally closed his eyes and rested his mind, silently sorting out the laws of heaven and deducing the direction of the catastrophe, and his mind was calm and calm. But the next moment, the Dao seal between his eyebrows trembled slightly, and the pure and upright Dao rhyme that was flowing smoothly around him quietly stagnated for half a minute.
The extremely subtle changes cannot be noticed by ordinary people, golden immortals and even quasi-sages, but in the eyes of saints like Yuan Shi who are in charge of the order of the heavens and have insight into the origin of heaven, they are so clear that it is dazzling.
He slowly opened his eyes, with the stars and rivers swirling in his eyes and the ups and downs of the law. His eyes swept across the southeastern sky, and his tone was calm and calm, with a hint of scrutiny: "The southeastern land of beauty, the heavenly secrets are chaotic, and the Taoism is retrograde."
At first, Yuanshi didn't take it to heart.
The catastrophe of the Conferring God is approaching step by step, and the seals of the heavenly path are being unsealed layer by layer. There are opportunities to change and the heavenly secrets are shaking everywhere in the ancient world. Dao rhyme fluctuations appear in the southeast corner. This is an ordinary chaos within reason.
In his initial judgment, this was just another innate secret realm opening and a low-level opportunity appearing in the world. There was no need for the saint to personally go out, he only needed to send his disciples to explore and seize the opportunity.
Chan Jiao has always acted like this, sitting firmly on the high platform, deducing opportunities, sending disciples to compete for luck, never rushing to dangerous places in person, and always maintaining the dignity and calmness of the leader of Xuanmen.
Yuan Shi raised his hand, a ray of clear light flowing on his fingertips, trying to deduce the whole picture, locking the chance level and the coordinates of the formation eye. He planned to find out the details and then calmly send his disciples to pick peaches.
But this time, the fingertip deduction was not as smooth and transparent as usual.
The moment the clear light touched the southeastern secret, it was suddenly blocked and rebounded by a thick and vast layer of chaotic mist. Countless broken, chaotic, and twisted fragments of the secret poured in crazily, densely filling the deduction context.
"Huh?"
Yuan Shi's brows furrowed slightly, and there was a bit of surprise in his eyes.
Ordinary secret realms and innate restrictions cannot stop the saint's deduction at all, let alone rebound the charm of Yuxu Dao and distort the context of heaven. Such a thick covering of chaos cannot be obtained by ordinary chance.
He restrained his contempt and stopped making random deductions. The holy path between his brows was operating at full strength, and the vast and majestic power of the saint was poured into the heavenly secrets. He forcibly pushed aside the layers of fog, tore apart the layers of cover, and insisted on spying on the truth of the changes in the southeast.
As the fog of chaos was pushed aside layer by layer, the broken fragments of the secret gradually came together, and an original aura that transcended innateness and approached the avenue slowly surfaced.
Chaos energy!
The pure, majestic, and ancient aura of the origin of chaos, separated by hundreds of millions of miles of void, is still clearly transmitted into the Yuxu Heavenly Palace, majestic and vast, crushing the heavens.
YuanShi's eyes suddenly condensed, his knuckles that were originally loose tightened quietly, and his cold face lost its calmness for the first time and became a little more solemn.
"A change in the chaos level?"
He whispered to himself, and many thoughts surged through his heart.
The appearance of Qinglian, the fifth heavenly seal in the previous series, was a top opportunity derived from the origin of Pangu. It should have fallen into the hands of Chanjiao, but in the end, it was restrained by all parties and missed the first move, allowing the side sects to take advantage of the loophole, and missed the chance of a chaos-level treasure.
This matter has always been a thorn in Yuan Shi's heart. It seems to be calm, but in fact he is deeply worried.
As the leader of the Explanation Sect, he is in charge of the ancient orthodox legal principles, but he has missed the top opportunities of heaven one after another. Watching the steady rise of other families' power and the skyrocketing foundation has already made him impatient and forbearing.
Now that there is another change in the way of heaven at the chaotic level, it is undoubtedly another key opportunity to rewrite the pattern since the beginning of the catastrophe.
The restraint in Yuanshi's heart has quietly loosened.
